query:
SELECT 
  (SELECT id FROM plants WHERE name LIKE '%Lavande%' LIMIT 1) as lavande_id,
  (SELECT id FROM molecules WHERE name LIKE '%Linalol%' LIMIT 1) as linalol_id,
  (SELECT id FROM molecules WHERE name LIKE '%Camphre%' LIMIT 1) as camphre_id,
  (SELECT id FROM molecules WHERE name LIKE '%Cinéole%' OR name LIKE '%Cineole%' LIMIT 1) as cineole_id;
